/**
 * An avatar group is an element that communicates to the user that there is
 * more than 1 person associated to an item. It contains two avatar
 * components with modifying classes.
 *
 * @summary Avatar Groups are used to bunch together avatars within a shared context
 *
 * @base
 * @name avatar-group
 * @selector .slds-avatar-group
 * @support dev-ready
 * @category base
 * @type data-display
 * @layout responsive
 * @synonyms identity, face pile
 */
